domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWBtYWqaV8NhvUrShB

Likely cause of the 403, read 2026-11-02T14:11Z: GitHub added per-user rate limits on NEW private vulnerability reports on 2026-10-01 (changelog: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-01-rate-limits-for-private-vulnerability-reports). The limit caps how many new reports one account may submit in a day, per repository and across GitHub; comments on existing advisories are not limited. Repository admins can set a custom daily limit and add trusted reporters to an allow list that is never rate limited (repository Settings → Advanced Security, beside "Private vulnerability reporting"). The changelog gives no default number and does not say whether an App's bot account can be allow-listed.

That fits the measurement: every `advisory_report` is submitted as the one App account, so the whole fleet shares one reporter's daily budget; the first report of the day landed and every later one, from any session, was refused.

So for this card: (a) `isProxyRefusal` and the hidden message are still defects, since they turned a documented platform limit into "egress proxy" and no back-off; (b) `references/rest-channel.md` / `security-findings.md` should record the limit and its seat-side rule (one report per day unless the bot is a trusted reporter; on a 403 stop and hand the rest to the maintainer). Allow-listing the bot, or raising the limit, is a maintainer setting.
